name: Doki Doki College Club 2
summary:
Doki Doki College Club 2 is a sequel to the original Doki Doki College Club, both of which are intended as parody mods. While the first leaned slightly more into the original game's format, both mods use satire and absurdist humor. The humor may not appeal to everyone, and some references are intentionally obscure.

It’s recommended to play the first mod before starting this one, as it provides context for the characters and story. If you enjoyed the first, this sequel builds on it with more content and polish. Development of this mod was more ambitious, with significantly more time spent on writing and design—estimated at around 200 hours.
